entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕炉窗，炉灶的窗眼／通风口；西语词头 panillos…拼写残损无法还原
entries.en: doubtful: hearth window, vent or opening of a stove; Spanish headword garbled (panillos- bra usa.)
entries.notes: L 栏拼写残损无法还原且 T99 污损，释义仅据 H（炉窗）M（lū hang）两栏，西语词头无法定夺

entries.zh: 分：部分；份儿（mi parte 我的那一份）；分掉、分开（ṡ. partio）
entries.en: part; share, one's portion (mi parte); to divide, to part with

entries.zh: 断：截断、砍断；断绝；决断
entries.en: to cut off, sever; to break off; to decide
entries.notes: L 栏 slava- 拼写无法还原，释义依 H（断）M（…toan＝toāⁿ）两栏；M 另有 quy 音待考

entries.zh: 毫：一里亚尔（real）的十分之一，货币最小单位
entries.en: a tenth part of a real; the smallest unit of money

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕疑为世界之一方／一隅（par te del mundo）；字待考（掊/培，音 pou）
entries.en: doubtful: a part or quarter of the world (par te del mundo); character uncertain (掊/培)
entries.notes: L 栏后半 olua ʃic 残损、H 栏带[疑]且 T99，四栏无法互证

entries.zh: 分内：本分之内，属于自己份内的
entries.en: within one's own part or share; one's duty, what properly falls to one

entries.zh: 大小片：大小不等的碎片、块片（不等的部分）
entries.en: pieces big and small; unequal parts

entries.zh: 分外：本分之外；额外的、分外的
entries.en: beyond one's part or share; extra, outside one's lot

entries.zh: 男根，男子阴私处（parte secreta del hombre）
entries.en: man's private parts; the male member
entries.notes: H 栏字形（王夾）难解，疑系俗写或误读；释义依 L（parte secreta del hombre）与 M（lān…）两栏互证

entries.zh: 参与政事，共理政务（攝政事）
entries.en: to take part in government; to share in governing affairs (comunicarse)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（西语 particularmente：特别地、逐条地；汉字与注音栏皆空）
entries.en: doubtful: particularly, item by item (particularmente); Chinese and phonetic columns empty
entries.notes: H/M/R 三栏皆[空]，无从定夺对当词

entries.zh: 私：私自的、个人的；自家的（家己）、专有的
entries.en: private; one's own, particular, proper (propria)

entries.zh: 分：分开、分割；分派
entries.en: to divide, to split; to apportion
entries.notes: M 栏并录 pún 一读（或并注另读／涉"本"字），不影响语义

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕西语词头栏[空]；字待考（鎊/鏳，音 peng）
entries.en: doubtful: Spanish headword column empty; character uncertain (鎊/鏳, read peng)
entries.notes: L 栏[空]且 H 栏带[疑]、T99，语义无从定夺

entries.zh: 剖：剖开、剖分
entries.en: to cut open, split open; to dissect

entries.zh: 对半分开，从中划开（rayar por medio 从中间划线）
entries.en: to split in two, to halve; to draw a line through the middle
entries.notes: H（分分）M（pún hun）与西语词头对应欠明，释义依 L"rayar por medio"定为对半分开；L 尾 vt fraula 残损

entries.zh: 分割：分开成几部分，切开
entries.en: to divide into parts, to cut asunder

entries.zh: 排分：分派、摊分（挨次分配）
entries.en: to divide and distribute, to deal out shares

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（西语疑为 partir en tres, dos o…：分成三份、两份……；汉字与注音栏皆空）
entries.en: doubtful: perhaps "partir en tres, dos o …" (to divide into three, two, …); Chinese and phonetic columns empty
entries.notes: H/M/R 三栏皆[空]，L 尾 omy 残损

entries.zh: 平分：均分，平均分开
entries.en: to divide equally, to share evenly
entries.notes: M 栏音节多于汉字数（或含展开注语），语义依 L（ygualmente）与 H（平分）定为均分
